newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Quake shakes northern Israel, no injuries or damage.
newsitem.headline: Quake shakes northern Israel, no injuries or damage.

text.p: An earthquake shook northern Israel on Monday but Israeli officials said there were no injuries or damage.

"At 12:30 p.m. (0930 GMT) there was an earthquake measuring 3.9 (on the Richter scale) in the northern Hula valley," a spokeswoman for the Geophysical Institute's seismology branch said in a statement to the media.
She said Israelis in the area reported they barely felt the tremor.
